maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from software (Venue VDR, ActiveDisclosure, Arc Suite) and transaction-driven compliance filings, not repairing or replacing installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private companies, investment funds, banks and law firms buying filing, data room and compliance software and services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from its own software and compliance products, such as Venue and ActiveDisclosure, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: SEC filings, regulatory reporting (Arc Suite) and deal data rooms are compliance-critical, with workflow embedded and high switching risk.

notes: Part of revenue is transaction-driven (IPOs, M&A) and print/proxy services, which could vary; the answers reflect the larger software and compliance part.
